title: Atlas of Feeling
subtitle: The Atlas of Human Feeling
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: A guide to every human emotion — 33 chapters, one per emotion, explaining what each feeling is, why it exists, and how to live with it.
style: Warm, precise, accessible prose. Each chapter: definition, science, lived experience, practical guidance.
characters: The reader — anyone learning to understand their emotions.
notes: Continue with the next emotion in sequence (the book has 33 planned chapters). Structure each chapter like the existing ones: what the emotion is, where it comes from, how it shows up, how to work with it.
